text: I'm sorry to hear that your weekend walking partner has moved away. It's completely normal to feel a bit lonely with the change. You might consider keeping the walking time in your schedule and deciding whether to go alone or invite someone else to join you. It's also a good idea to reach out to your friend and ask if they'd like to arrange an occasional call. Keep in mind that their availability may be different now, so it's best to agree on a plan together rather than assuming a particular frequency.
